definitions.explanation: The act of intentionally taking one's own life.

examples.japanese: {自殺|じさつ}⟦{予防|よぼう}→予防：03669_yobou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are counseling services for suicide prevention.

examples.english: He attempted suicide due to financial problems.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{自殺|じさつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{防|ふせ}ぐ→防ぐ：02409_fusegu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧⟦{体制|たいせい}→体制：04490_taisei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強化|きょうか}→強化：00260_kyouka⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。

examples.english: In Japan, support for people who have attempted suicide is a pressing issue.

notes:
{自殺|じさつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ is used as a する-verb meaning "to commit suicide."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {自殺|じさつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to commit suicide)
- {自殺|じさつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{図|はか}る→図る：12006_hakaru⟧ (to attempt suicide)
- {自殺|じさつ}⟦{未遂|みすい}→未遂：13085_misui⟧ (attempted suicide)
- {自殺|じさつ}⟦{予防|よぼう}→予防：03669_yobou⟧ (suicide prevention)
- {自殺|じさつ}⟦{率|りつ}→率：03802_ritsu⟧ (suicide rate)

Note: This is a sensitive topic. In Japan, there are help resources like "⟦いのち→命：02371_inochi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧" (Inochi no Denwa - Lifeline).
